scope: Proposition 8.1 of the manuscript “Topological triviality of mu-constant families of surface singularities” (preprints/Topological-triviality-of-mu-constant-families-of-surface-singularities-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 064 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 133a57483691850c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let F(x, t) = ft(x) satisfy the hypotheses of the main theorem. Assume that X0 = {f0 = 0} is not log canonical and that β(Xt, 0) is constant. After shrinking the parameter disk and making a finite base change t = ue, there is a proper modification b : N −→ X′ = {F(x, ue ) = 0} such that N → ∆u is smooth, b is an isomorphism off the origin section, and its reduced exceptional divisor E has relative normal crossings. The restriction bu is the minimal semigood resolution, and E|Nu is its full reduced exceptional divisor.
